update: The Red Reef is Out Today!
change: Fixed a bug where Partner slayer did not correctly enforce the "15 shared tasks" requirement.
Fixed an issue with Partner Slayer allowing for accounts to receive the 5,000 XP boss task completion bonus without having killed any bosses towards the task.
Metal dragon tasks now correctly require 150–200 kills instead of 90–120 when "Pedal to the Metals" is unlocked.

* Fixed an issue where bloodveld and nechryael tasks could be assigned without completing Priest in Peril.
* Fixed an issue where Partner Slayer didn’t properly respect quest requirements - it should now work as intended.
* Fixed an issue where dragon tasks incorrectly required full completion of Dragon Slayer I - they now only require it to be started.

* Fixed a bug where Slayer masters weren't respecting the 'Ignore Combat Level' setting, which could stop players from receiving tasks they were otherwise eligible for.
* Fixed a bug where Slayer masters wouldn't provide tips for Jad and Zuk tasks, leaving the advice dialogue blank.
An issue has been fixed where Partner Slayer could assign tasks that one partner didn’t meet the requirements for.

* The following Slayer point unlocks have been adjusted. Any previously purchased unlocks were refunded automatically upon login:
** Slug Salter has been reduced from 80 to 10 points.
** The Reptile Freezer has been reduced from 90 to 10 points.
** Ring Bling has been reduced from 300 to 150 points.
** Bigger and Badder has been reduced from 150 to 50 points.
** Task Storage has been reduced from 1000 points 500 points.
** Petal to the Metal has been increased from 100 to 200 points, to account for all metal dragons now that they are under one task. The previous unlocks and extensions for mithril, adamant and rune dragons (I Hope You Mith Me, I really Mith You, Ada'mind Some More and RUUUUUNE) were removed.
* Each Slayer Master now has their own individual block list for tasks with varying costs:
** Turael, Aya and Spria blocked tasks now cost 40 points.
** Mazchna/Achtryn blocked tasks now cost 50 points.
** Vannaka blocked tasks now cost 70 points.
** Chaeldar blocked tasks now cost 70 points.
** Konar blocked tasks now cost 80 points.
** Nieve/Steve blocked tasks now cost 90 points.
** Duradel/Kuradal blocked tasks now cost 100 points.
** Krystilia blocked tasks now cost 100 points.
* Blocking a task prevents that specific master from assigning it again, without affecting other Slayer masters.
* There is now a warning if you attempt to block a task that the selected Slayer master does not assign.
* Points for previously blocked tasks were automatically refunded upon login.
* Shared block lists only apply to Turael, Aya and Spria, with all other masters having unique block lists.
* The Task Storage can now store Wilderness tasks.
Boss tasks that can only be completed solo now award the correct amount of points if a player is on a task with a partner.
The Slayer partner system is reintroduced.

poll: Poll 83 - Castle Wars, New Player Changes & More
change:
Dedicated Castle Wars world changes:

* You can now only enter through the Guthix (green) portal to ensure more balanced teams.
* Players will now earn 1 additional Castle wars ticket for participating in a game.
* On members worlds, players are now granted plaudits alongside tickets which can be used to purchase Castle Wars supply crates via Lanthus.

All Castle Wars world changes:

* The Castlewars brew now also applies the effects of a stamina potion and super restore when consumed. 
** The reduction in run energy depletion associated with stamina potions won't occur on free-to-play worlds.
* Helmets can now be worn in Castle Wars, enabling the use of equipment set effects.
* Bandages now scale with your Hitpoints level and can overheal, similar to anglerfish.
* Castle Wars bracelets can now be handed to Lanthus to store charges, automatically consuming one per game.
* You can now use blighted food and cast Vengeance with blighted rune sacks while in the Castle Wars lobby.
* Players now receive a rune pouch when entering Castle Wars, providing unlimited runes for select spells. 
** These spells do not grant Magic experience when cast. To earn full Magic experience, players must provide their own runes.
* A new barricade cap on dedicated Castle Wars worlds restricts teams to 7 barricades outside and 10 inside the base.
* Barricades placed now have a coloured rope to indicate what team they belong to.
* Barricades can now be placed in front of the respawn barriers.
* A new element has been added to the Castle Wars Heads-Up Display, showing the number of barricades your team has placed both inside and outside your base.
* Small walls have been added to the stairs and ladder at the respawn point, allowing players to range over them and create more strategic barricade placements.
* On non-Castle Wars worlds, players within Castle Wars will be able to shove targets back-to-back using the dragon spear and Zamorakian hasta special attacks.
* There is now a table with buckets in the supply room where the bucket spawn used to be.
* Fixed a bug where the player's overhead yellow arrow would not disappear after depositing the flag.
Locator orbs can now be brought into the minigame.
On the recommended Castle Wars Worlds, players now need a skill total of 500 or more if they want to set up barricades. Players without that level are welcome to use the barricades on other worlds.

* Potion supply tables have been placed in the starting room for each respective game in Castle Wars.
* A new notification has been added to the game, directing players to Castle Wars worlds.

* A warning now appears if a player hits the stack limit and cannot receive a scroll box.

** Clue completion totals per tier
** Current scroll capacity per tier

** Players now have the chance to obtain extra points if extra coins are deposited between thresholds. 
*** Any remainder coins now give you a corresponding percentage chance at an extra point.
** The Alchemy Guardian is now static and visible from every cupboard you might be standing in front of.
** The cupboards are now open by default and will only close for a moment when the items are being changed.
** Players will no longer be warned when casting Alchemy on untradeable items from within this room.

** Players may now take up to 5 items at a time by right-clicking the cupboards.
* The Enchanting Chamber
** Magic experience is now granted for deposited objects.
** We now store the bonus Rune rewards for players to claim when they leave the room, rather than giving them out when objects are deposited.
** There is now a 1/32 chance of finding dragonstone while searching for shapes in the Enchanting Chamber.

** Bonus runes that used to be given on depositing fruit are now given upon exiting the room.
** Depositing fruit will now reward 5 experience for a banana and 10 experience for a peach.

** Peaches now count as two portions of fruit when deposited in a chute.

To prevent some unwanted behaviour where NPCs neither retaliate nor retreat, there has been a change to how NPCs decide whether they retreat or retaliate. In particular, this affects how monsters such as Callisto and Vet'ion will behave when lured to the limits of their wander range. This change applies to all monsters with long range attacks.

A game engine bug affecting the retaliation of ranging/maging NPCs has been fixed. In particular, this affects Venenatis and Vet'ion and their behaviour when they have moved far from their spawn points, so it will make certain safespots considerably less effective, and will have similar effects on other NPCs with long-range attacks.

update: Deadman: Armageddon & While Guthix Sleeps Tweaks
change:
* Texts and dialogues throughout the quest have been adjusted to bring it in line with the quest in RuneScape 2.
* A chest has been added to Movario's base that contains the runes players may need to open the old battered door.
* Thaerisk will now give players one snapdragon seed for free, rather than charging roughly half the Grand Exchange value of the seed.

*Multiple changes were made to increase the quest's difficulty in order to make it comparable to other Grandmaster quests:
** Surok Magis
*** Players no longer heal off of Surok when using blood spells.
*** Surok's elemental surge attack no longer has its damage reduced by Protect from Magic.
** Balance Elemental
*** The Balance Elemental's maximum hit was drastically increased.
*** The Balance Elemental's stat-lowering attack now also drains prayer points.
*** The Balance Elemental now requires all three combat styles to be defeated, as it will no longer change its protection prayers after a certain amount of time.
* Surok's lit explosives can now be alchemised regardless of whether or not the alchemy untradeable item warning is on.

Tormented demons are now less likely to lose aggression with the player when they run out of range. If they do, they will attack the player correctly if the player re-engages them.

update: God Wars Instancing and Soul Wars Improvements
change:
* The inactivity timer will begin to tick down 10 seconds after a game starts instead of immediately.
* Items in the "Other" section of the Reward Shop can now be examined.
* The tutorial will now properly display the chatheads of bearded players.
* The duration in which players cannot exit a Graveyard has been reduced from 15 seconds to 10. In addition, players will now receive immunity when exiting, which lasts for a few seconds or until another player is attacked.
* Attempting to attack Avatars from outside the boss room will now cause the minigame to pull the player in, instead of a message telling them to move closer.

* Rebalanced the quantities of certain items in the Spoils of War.

Also, after the initial launch of Soul Wars and the addition of new worlds to handle all the players wanting to try it out, we have decided that we will be continuing with 3 Soul Wars worlds, one in each global region:

* 320 US
* 350 UK
* 535 AUS

* The activity bar now takes 150 seconds to fully deplete rather than 120.
* Ultimate Ironmen can now use the looting bag during a game.
* The loot table for spoils of war have been adjusted, reducing quantities of runite ore and seeds. In addition, dragon items, rune items, seeds, and runite ore are now rarer.
* Items which transform the player (such as the ring of stone and ring of coins) can no longer be used during a game.
* A confirmation message will now appear when attempting to leave the lobby.

change:

* A new fog mechanic, greater fog, has been added to Last Man Standing:
** Players less than 16 tiles into the fog will take 1-3 damage per tick.
** Players 16 tiles or more into the fog will take 10 damage every other tick.
The combat option on other players is now always left-click, regardless of the player's settings or combat level outside the minigame.
An active Spellbook Swap is now cancelled at the beginning of Last Man Standing.
A bug was fixed where the Occult Necklace was not being dropped upon death for the Max/Med and Zerker modes in Last Man Standing.

Binding spell effects are now wiped more reliably at the end of a Last Man Standing session.

* The bow of Faerdhinen has been removed from loot crates and chests.
* Pures are now unable to use Lunar Spells, as players with level 1 Defence cannot normally access them.

* Rune gloves have been changed to mithril ones for Pure builds.
* Visible Special Attack bars have been added to the zaryte crossbow, dragon knives, and light ballista.

* 2 new account build have been added to the minigame: Zerker and 1 Def pure.
* The warmup countdown duration at the beginning of the game has been increased from 7 to 12 seconds.
* Yellow notifications on the heads-up display should no longer overlap with the buff bar on official clients.
* The buff bar will also no longer show the minigame's ammo after players have left the battle arena.
* Drop item warnings and valuable loot notifications are now suppressed inside the minigame.
* As an experiment, protection prayers are now more effective. Damage is now reduced to 30%, up from 60%.
* The starting positions for players in the Wild Varrock map has been updated. The map now uses pairs of spawn points rather than clumps of six, making it more like the spawns on the Desert Island map.
* Loot crates are now more likely to spawn closer to the final safe zone in the Wild Varrock map.
* Loot chests and crates will now check what items you already have when deciding what to give you.

update: PvP Balancing, LMS, and Elf Graphics
change:

poll: Chambers of Xeric Room Improvements
change:
* General
** Added a new 'Reload' option to the lobby staircase, allowing the raid leader to generate a new layout and boot anyone in the current instance.
** Added a new scaling option to the recruitment board party interface, allowing the raid leader to increase the raid's difficulty without requiring additional players.
** Energy wells have been placed throughout the raid.
** Various unnoted consumable items (namely common food and potions) will now appear to other players when dropped.
** Sped up the growth times of buchu, golpar and noxifer plants.
* Scavengers
** Since scavengers roll multiple drops, it is possible to get multiple sets of the components above.
** Tweaked drops so that whenever any potion secondary would be dropped, scavengers now drop 3-11 stinkhorn mushrooms, 3-6 cicely and 5-14 endarkened juice.
** Scavengers now only roll two drops at a time.
** Sped up both the Mining and Woodcutting shortcuts, which now provide points comparable with the boulder shortcut.
** Mallignum root planks are now stackable.
* Tekton
** The first dragon warhammer special attack against Tekton is now guaranteed to hit.
** Tekton no longer resets his Defence when healing at the anvil.
* Crabs
** Players can no longer 'splash' on crabs if their Magic bonus is higher than -64.
** Attacks no longer have any delay after hitting a crab. If your attack changes the crab's colour, you will not automatically re-attack.
* Ice Demon
** Kindling is now stackable, up to a cap of 28.
** Lighting braziers and burning kindling now provide more points.
** Ice demon drops stinkhorn mushroom, endarkened juice and cicely to each player when defeated.
** Reduced the ice demon's Magic defence from 60 to 40.
* Vanguards
** Vanguards drops have been standardized with overload drop mechanics remaining unchanged.
** Melee Vanguard now drops 2 Xeric's aid and an elder potion.
** Ranged Vanguard now drops 1 Xeric's aid, 2 revitalisation potions and a twisted potion.
** Magic Vanguard now drops 1 Xeric's aid, 1 prayer enhance and a kodai potion.
* Thieving
** Increased the chance to successfully steal from chests.
** Cavern grubs are stackable up to a cap of 28.
** Successful chest openings now guarantee a minimum of one cavern grub.
** Slightly increased the points given per cavern grub.
** Players now receive stinkhorn mushrooms, endarkened juice and cicely upon completion.
* Vespula
** Increased lux grubs' HP from 100 to 125.
** Medivaemia blossoms now heal lux grubs for 35 HP, up from 20.
** Reduced the Ranged and Melee strength of Vespula and vespine soldiers.
** Reduced abyssal portal healing for vespine soldiers.
** Vespula now drops a guaranteed Overload(+).
* Vasa Nistirio
** Reduced Vasa's Ranged defence.
** Vasa will now only heal if a crystal isn't destroyed in time.
** Vasa now drops a guaranteed Overload(+).
* Mystics
** A handy set of portals will now appear after all mystics are defeated, allowing for easier traversal across the room.
* Muttadiles
** Adjusted the damage formula for the meat tree to be more consistent.
** Both muttadiles will attempt to heal at the meat tree when reduced below 50% HP (up from 40%).
** Both muttadiles can now be damaged while frozen, even if they were trying to move towards the meat tree.
** Reduced the max hits of both muttadiles.
** Big muttadile will now only swap between Magic and Ranged attacks after using the same style three times, not counting Melee attacks.
* Great Olm
** Olm's portal swap special now spawns a portal within 10 tiles of players in a solo encounter.
** Olm's healing pool attack now has a 'cooldown' of 10 attacks.

* A bank chest has been added inside the raid lobby, which can be used prior to beginning a raid.
* Two storage units have been added to the Great Olm's antechamber for ease of access without having to climb back up a level.

update: The New Renderer Beta is Out Today!
change: The drop rate for elite clue scrolls has increased from 1/66 to 1/30.

* A bug in which the Emberlight's special attack was reducing Yama's Strength level instead of Defence has been fixed.
* Yama's offensive stats can now be drained outside of contracts, capped to level 200 Attack and Strength.

* The boosted pet drop rate from the contract of familiar acquisition now applies to both players if they are in the same group ironman team.
* Emberlight's special attack no longer reduces Yama's offensive stats to prevent him from being rendered harmless via repeated stat drains.
* Enchanted ruby and diamond bolt special effects no longer trigger when fighting Yama during the contract of glyphic attenuation to enforce the intended melee-only strategy.

* Contractually Unbound is now retroactively completed if players owned a piece of the purifying sigil or radiant oathplate armour before 29 May 2025.
* A bug in which Shadow dancer would fail if players were hit by Yama's shadow waves as they were being teleported away between phase transitions has been fixed.
* Void flares that spawn with reduced health during the contract of divine severance and contract of familiar acquisition fights have had their health decreased from 83 to 81.
* The drop rate for Yami from the contract of familiar acquisition has been increased from 1/250 to 1/100. Additionally, both players will benefit from the contract of whoever used it - unless one of the players is an ironman, in which case they will need to provide their own to benefit from the increased rate.

* Combat Achievements have been added for Yama. Unlike previous Combat Achievement releases, speed times were not tracked on release, and opening the Combat Achievements interface will not automatically complete kill count tasks; players must kill Yama after this update to complete them.
** Additionally, players who have completed at least one sigil contract before this update will not have automatically completed Contractually Unbound.
* It was stated that the drop rate for elite clue scrolls were increased from 1/66 to 1/30, but this did not occur.
* The dragon chainbody has been removed from Yama's collection log entry; this was due to the item originally being intended as a possible drop.
* Oathplate shards have been added to Yama's collection log entry; shards acquired prior to this update were tracked and thus will count as logged.
* Players can now bring 100 noted pineapple pizzas to Yama to initiate a fight, identical to the catalyst/shard/worm acquisition fights, as a way to practice the contract fights in exchange for standard loot rolls.
* The following adjustments have been made for contracted fights:
** Yama's health is no longer increased for all but two contracts.
** Yama's health for the contract of bloodied blows has been decreased from 4,125 to 3,000.
** Yama's health for the contract of glyphic attenuation has been decreased from 3,500 to 2,875.
** Phase transition thresholds have been changed to trigger at 75% and 50% health instead.
** Yama is once again vulnerable to demonbane weapons.
** Shadow pools will now only appear in the contracts of harmony and oathplate acquisition.
** Void flares in duo-eligible fights no longer always spawn at full health.
** Void flares will now always take successful hits from the player for the contract of bloodied blows.
** Magic and ranged prayer-penetration for the contract of bloodied blows has been decreased from 10% to 5%.
** Damage increases from higher prayer bonuses for the contract of glyphic attenuation have been increased to make the damage bonus larger at higher thresholds.

*The dossier drop rate has been increased from 1/17 to 1/12.
*Fixed the void flare bug in the Contract of bloodied blows which caused them to be unaffected by Wretched Strength.
*Fixed the void flare bug in the Contract of divine severance fight that made it impossible to clear; three of these would spawn at full health in enrage phase, but this was originally intended for a duo fight. This unintentionally carried over to solo, and it was not possible to deal the necessary 420 damage in 20 ticks, as not destroying them completely would result in instant death.

update: Game Improvements and Email Linking for Mobile Accounts
change: Damage dealt with imbued tephra now scales to the player's Smithing and Runecraft levels.

*The Zalcano drop table has been updated again. The chance of landing on the crystal tool seed table is now 1/200 with a 1/8000 chance of getting an uncut onyx. The Zalcano shard has been removed from this table and will now be rolled as a tertiary drop (like pets). The amount of mithril, gold and silver ore received as drops has also been reduced.

update: Nightmare Feedback and the Zalcano Loot Table
change:
*The MVP now no longer receives a second roll on the standard loot table, but instead gets 10% extra non-unique loot.
*Every kill will now trigger a 1/500 roll which, if it passes, will add a unique to the drop table. A separate roll will then be made to decide which unique that will be. Finally, the unique is given to an eligible player, the likelihood of which is determined upon each player's participation. This does not apply to Smolcano, the pet drop.
*The non-unique drop table for Zalcano has been rebalanced to include less valuable items.

*Zalcano's symbols now take slightly longer before dealing damage.
*The damage taken when standing beneath Zalcano after she's been knocked down has been reduced.
*The quick-pass option on Zalcano's prison barrier has been removed, as it served a limited purpose.
*The falling rocks during the Zalcano encounter now deal damage when hitting the floor rather than the player to be consistent with other similar mechanics.
*Zalcano now takes a consistent amount of time to destroy the glowing rock.
*Zalcano's death animation has been extended to prevent her from reappearing for a brief moment.
*The drops from the golem will now only be given to the player who deals the most damage.

update: SOTE Changes and Small Game Updates
change:
*Players who contribute a fair amount now receive a drop on Zalcano's better loot table, with the quantities of items being received scaling based on individual contribution.
*Everybody above a certain threshold of contributing will have a chance of receiving any of the unique drops, including the pet, with the chance scaling based on individual contribution.
*The MVP still receives Zalcano's additional drop, but from a "lesser" drop table
*Tick manipulation can no longer be used to mine the tephra and Zalcano much faster.
The floor mural and the tiles at the Gauntlet now render in the correct order.
The amount of crystal shards obtained from The Gauntlet and The Corrupted Gauntlet has increased from 3-7 to 5-9 and 5-9 to 7-12 respectively.
Crystalline spiders have been brought back.
Due to a bug which caused crystalline spiders to phase in and out of visibility, they have been temporarily replaced with crystalline rats.
Filling vials in The Gauntlet no longer interrupts fishing.
Entering and leaving The Gauntlet with an amulet of avarice equipped will no longer clear the player's skull.
The minimum HiScores 'killcount' required for The Corrupted Gauntlet has been lowered from 10 to 5.

poll: A Night At The Theatre and Old School Content Poll 75: PvM
change:
* Players can now make escape crystals to teleport out of the Gauntlet instantly to avoid loss of hardcore ironman status.
* Players can now make crystal paddlefish, which heals 16 Hitpoints and act as cooked karambwan in that they can be eaten without delay.

The enhanced crystal weapon seed has replaced the inactive Blade of Saeldor in the reward chest drop table, and the blade, as well as the Bow of Faerdhinen, can be created from the enhanced weapon seed.

poll: Old School Content Poll 71: Gauntlet, Grotesques, CoX and more
change:
*Messages that appear when receiving crystals in The Gauntlet are now filterable; this does affect the untradeable drop notification for crystal shards from monster drops.
*The max hits of all variants of the crystal and corrupted staves have been increased by 5.
*Filling vials and cooking paddlefish now occur in one tick (0.6 seconds).
*The inner square of rooms are now less randomised, and will always contain the same basic resources required to move on to the rest of The Gauntlet. This does not apply to the Corrupted Gauntlet.
*Players who have toggled the ability to automatically smash vials can now do so as soon as they've drunk the last dose of an egniol potion.
*Demi-bosses will now spawn in 6 of the 12 specific rooms of the Gauntlet's outer areas. The rooms in the outer area which they can spawn are the rooms non-adjacent to the corner rooms.
*The number of total resources required to create tier 2 and 3 armour have been reduced; the number of crystal shards required remain the same.
*The Crystalline and Corrupted Hunllef now play an animation right before changing attack styles to notify players to quickly change their protection prayers.
The Corrupted Gauntlet no longer gives extra Gauntlet capes to players who have one stored in a cape rack.
The Game Filter now filters the message displayed in the chatbox when players sing items at the Gauntlet's singing bowl.

*When creating items within the Gauntlet, the interface will remain open provided you have the ingredients to create other items.
*Killing a duplicate tier 3 creature within the Gauntlet will now have a guaranteed chance to drop a different powerful weapon component, provided you don't already have one. This was previously a 50% chance.
*The scoreboard in the Gauntlet lobby has been extended to display your deaths and the global deaths for each version of the Gauntlet.

update: SOTE Changes and Small Game Updates
change:
*The Crystalline and Corrupted Hunllef has been altered slightly: Ranged will always be the first attack style, damage has been increased when praying incorrectly (or not at all), and damage has been reduced when praying correctly.
*Players can no longer remove old school bonds from their bond pouch while in the Gauntlet.
The amount of crystal shards obtained from slayer monsters in the Iorwerth Dungeon has increased from 1 to 3-5, and the amount dropped by superior slayer monsters has increased from 1 to 6-10.

poll: Old School Content Poll 70: Game Improvements
change: The dungeon now contains Iorwerth Warriors, and the amount of monsters within the dungeon has been increased.

update: Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes
poll: Poll 81 - Mage Training Arena
change:
* The pizazz point cap for the Telekinetic Theatre has increased from 4,000 to 8,000.
* Completing a maze now rewards 250 Magic experience, which stacks with the existing experience rewards.
* Maze completion messaging is now more player-friendly.
* After completing five mazes, the player's run energy will be replenished.
* The Maze Guardian in the Telekinetic Theatre now moves faster.
The Telekinetic Theatre now allows movement of the guardian in the maze, so you can start walking to a new position while the guardian is responding to your last Telekinetic Grab spell.
Basilisk Knights now drop herbs unnoted instead of noted.
Basilisk knights now have a 40% elemental weakness to earth spells.

* Basilisk Knight's light and standard Ranged defence has been increased from 0 to 20.

update: Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One

*The knight's stats were increased.

*Basilisk Knights can no longer be safespotted.

update: Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes
poll: Poll 81 - Mage Training Arena
change:
* Players can now log out inside the Enchanting Chamber and retain their progress.
* The pizazz point cap for the Enchanting Chamber was doubled from 16,000 points to 32,000 points.
* Magic experience is now granted for deposited objects.
* Bonus rune rewards from depositing orbs are now stored and claimed when leaving the room, rather than after depositing orbs.
* There is a 1/32 chance of finding a dragonstone while searching for shapes in the Enchanting Chamber.
* There is at least one of each colour shape in every corner.
* A bug where no bonus points were awarded after enchanting the specified shape was fixed.
* Enchantment spells now award full Magic experience when cast in the Enchanting Chamber.

* The shapes in the Enchanting Chamber now give points equal to the level of the enchant spell used on them.
* The bonus for enchanting the correct shape in the Enchanting Chamber have been increased from 1 to 2.

update: Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes
poll: Poll 81 - Mage Training Arena
change:
* Players can now log out inside the Creature Graveyard and retain their progress.
* The pizazz point cap has increased from 4,000 to 8,000.
* Players will now only take damage from falling bones.
* Bonus runes that used to be given on depositing fruit are now given upon exiting the room.
* Depositing fruit will now reward 5 Magic experience for a banana and 10 experience for a peach.
* Bones to Bananas and Bones to Peaches can now be cast while running in this area.
* Bones to peaches tablets now work on bones in the Mage Training Arena.
* Peaches now count as two portions of fruit when deposited in a chute.
* Players can no longer bring certain bones that can be converted into fruit with them into the graveyard.

update: Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes
poll: Poll 81 - Mage Training Arena
change:
* Players can now log out inside the Alchemist's Playground and retain their progress.
* The pizazz point cap has increased from 8,000 to 16,000.
* Limit of 12,000 coins in a single deposit was removed.
* Players now have the chance to obtain extra pizzaz points if extra coins are deposited between thresholds. 
** Any remainder coins now give you a corresponding percentage chance at an extra point.
* The Alchemy Guardian is now static and visible from every cupboard you might be standing in front of.
* The cupboards are now open by default and will only close for a moment when the items are being changed. This should make getting items from cupboards less frustrating!
* Players will no longer be warned when casting Alchemy on untradeable items from within this room.
* The Alchemy value and positions of items will now only change once a minute.
* Players may now take up to 5 items at a time by right-clicking the cupboards.
The warning message displayed when attaching the ornate maul handle to the granite maul can now be disabled.
House Advertisements now remember the player's chosen sort order rather than defaulting to a reverse alphabetical sort every time players log in.

* Locked houses that are listed in house advertisements are now greyed out and removed from the board after 15 minutes.
* House advertisements no longer allows players to enter a house if the owner's privacy settings prevent the player from doing so.

poll: Old School Content Poll 72: Costume Rooms & Skilling
change:
*One of the loot rolls from the Grand Hallowed Coffin has been moved onto another coffin on the fifth level.

*The hallowed sack has been added to the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop.

Players will now cast the lowest level enchantment spell they currently have runes for when the hallowed focus is equipped, since players will always succeed in conjuring portals with it equipped.

*The instance limit for all floors has been increased from 10 to 15 players.
*The animation for fixing bridges will now show the same hammer the player is using.
*The north path fire trap on Floor 4 will now have a slightly different pattern for its first two rotations in order to make it easier to figure out the current position in the cycle.
*The Agility XP gained from treasure encounters on Floor 5 has been reduced from 100 to 80.

*The experience was rebalanced to offer less for not looting the coffins and offer more for looting. The Thieving experience for looting coffins was also increased.
*The Hallowed Focus now offers a 100% success rate in conjuring portal frames and speeds up the conjuration process.
*The strange old lockpick now also speeds up looting the coffins.
*The XP rates for each floor of the Hallowed Sepulchre have been adjusted: Floor 1: 500 (unchanged), Floor 2: 850 (unchanged), Floor 3: 1425 (down from 1500), Floor 4: 2625 (down from 2700), Floor 5: 5850 (down from 6000)
*Completing a treasure encounter on a floor will now award the following amounts of XP: Floor 1: 100 (unchanged), Floor 2: 100 (unchanged), Floor 3: 150 (up from 100), Floor 4: 150 (up from 100), Floor 5: 200 (up from 100)

*The hallowed grapple and hammer now offer a 100% success rate on pillars and bridges respectively. The bridges are also traversed faster.
*Navigating through the prayer barrier whilst wearing a hallowed symbol has been sped up slightly and the Prayer experience for sacrificing vampyre dust has been increased from 60 to 200.
*The Magic experience for conjuring portal frames has been increased from 20 to 200 and the portals attempt to put the player in range when clicked from a distance.
*All treasure encounters will now award a small amount of Agility experience when completed. This will happen twice per encounter.
*Stationary sword traps will no longer hit from further away than they should and the fire trap animations will now appear at the same time players take damage from them. The fire trap on the north path of floor 4 has also been reverted back to its original rotation on release, and the south path on floor 4 will now load the entire section to prevent a loading screen while avoiding bolts.
*Players can no longer use barbarian training methods to light fires in the Hallowed Sepulchre.
*If a ghost spawns when looting the grand coffin it will now always be the Archpriest of the Unicorn instead of the knights.

*The bolt projectile is now larger and glows, and the glow on the ground cast by the bolt is no longer bolt shaped. The tier 3 bolt projectiles now have the same hitbox as tier 1 and 2 and all bolt traps are now more forgiving when trying to move two tiles perpendicular to them.
*Sword traps will stop appearing where they should not be and the timing of a sword trap on floor 3 is now a bit more forgiving.
*The statue animations for the fire traps should now be in-sync and the fire traps on floors 1 and 2 will turn on and off at the same rate as the fire traps on floors 3 and 4.
*Players can no longer make their way (e.g. by building a bridge) to a coffin when the time has run out as it could not be looted regardless. The timer will also disappear when time runs out.
*Ghosts will now spawn after the loot is collected to not interrupt the action. They will also stop stealing the player's loot when their dialogue is interrupted.
*Players will now receive slightly more hallowed marks on floors 1–3 and slightly fewer on floors 4 and 5 (including the Grand Coffin), and players can now loot multiple coffins on floors 3 and 4. The rarity of the strange old lockpick has been adjusted to account for the multiple chests available on each floor.
*Players can now enter the barrier leading to the Grand Coffin while stood on either side of it and instances where players would be stuck when descending to a new floor have been resolved.
*The price of hallowed tokens has been decreased from 15 hallowed marks to 10 and hallowed items can no longer be alchemised.
*The amount of experience gained after completing a floor has been decreased.
*On floor 2, some blue teleport pads have been added to the north, east and west paths, and the last fire trap on the east path now has a more reasonable respawn coordinate if players fail at the end of it.
*On floor 3, the first sword traps on the west and east path now wait five cycles between catching and throwing the sword so that they are slightly more forgiving, and the firing rate of the bolts on the final trap has been slowed down by one tick.
*On floor 4, a missing pad has been added to the sword trap at the end of the north path to indicate where the sword stops, the sword and fire trap combination on the south path now has two possible solutions to reduce the amount of wait time, the last two flames of the fire trap on the northern path are now active on every rotation, and the final bolt and teleport pad combination on the south path now has some blue teleport pads.
*On floor 5, the bolt statues for the final trap have been moved forward slightly so their animations can be seen more easily, and the first bolt and teleport pad combination trap now has a few more blue teleport tiles.

*Experience gained for completing a floor is no longer scaled down depending on the time remaining.
*All treasure encounters are now enabled.
*Leaving the Hallowed Sepulchre using an obelisk will now restore run energy if players are wearing Saradomin items.
*The Grand Hallowed Coffin now awards 8–12 Hallowed marks instead of 4–7 and provides two rolls on the high-tier coffin loot table.

*Fixed a bug that caused players to teleport to the entrance when completing floors. Personal best times have been reset due to this fix.

update: The New Renderer Beta is Out Today!
change: Players on the Official Client can now opt in to a new renderer beta.

* The AFK Logout Timer is now live on both the desktop and mobile versions of the Official Client, where players can adjust the logout timer from 5 up to 25 minutes.
* Fixed a bug where Steam achievements could be unlocked without the required progression.

* Fixed rendering issues with long submenus.
* Fixed a bug where loot tracker databases could become corrupted and cause stutters and crashes.
* Added a new "::repairlt" command for players to fix any pre-existing loot tracker issues.
The collection log is now in the hiscores panel in the sidebar.

* The HiScores panel now remembers the previously searched data set.
* Failed HiScore searching now displays a new UI and text within the search bar.
* A new toggle was added which allows chat filters to always show, even when chat is collapsed.
* The HiScores popout panel will now auto-open when the player uses the in-world lookup feature.
* The Barrows interface no longer gets stuck behind the minimap interface.
* The deadzones around the chatbox and the left side have been adjusted on the mobile client.
* Menus now appear in front of minimap orbs, and important functions like the close button won't be blocked when they overlap.
* Certain hotkeys with a corresponding checkbox or toggle in the settings menu now correctly sync to the correct state.
* The loot tracker no longer shows incorrect truncated numbers on the enhanced client.
* When using the hotkey side panel, the buff bar now dodges as it would if the player used the right-side stones.
A toggle has been added to highlight characters or scenery which can be interacted with to start a quest.

* A toggle has been added to break down loot gained from different events separately.
* A toggle has been added for untradeable items in the "Ground Item Overlay" options.
* Bank keys are now tracked via the Loot Tracker.
* Items in the Loot Tracker now include links to the Old School Wiki.
* A bug has been fixed on the mobile client that allowed players to talk to other player's pets.
* The client was added to the Jagex Launcher as the new standard official client.

* Players may now right-click a source in the Loot Tracker to ignore it.
* Players may now set the maximum number of items shown on their Ground Items list from the Settings menu.

* Clue scrolls obtained from the same location now stack in the Loot Tracker.
* Seed packs are now correctly tracked by the Loot Tracker.
* NPCs without drops have been removed from the Loot Tracker.
* Wintertodt is now spelled correctly in the Loot Tracker.

* Radimus Erkle is now correctly highlighted when using the Clue Scroll Helper.
* The Clue Helper no longer thinks a Round Blue Snelm can be used for the clue that requires a Pointy Blue Snelm.
* Morrigan's throwing Axe (bh) and Morrigan's javelin (bh) are no longer considered ammo.

The Loot Tracker will now correctly recognise and display the following:
* Pest Control rewards including coins and commendation points.
* The Chaos Elemental pet, whether it follows you or hides in your inventory.
* Barbarian Assault gambling rewards.
* Logs from Bruma roots – note that both the source and the loot itself will now appear correctly.
* Herbs from sprouting roots.

update: More Doom Tweaks, Poll 84, & Summer Sweep Up Changes
change: Purple drop rates in Tombs of Amascut now scale and interpolate between Raid Level invocations. Instead of only adjusting at 50-level intervals (350, 400, 450, 500), reward weightings are now adjusted every 5 Levels. This allows gradual increases in drop chances without requiring large jumps in difficulty.

* There is now a warning message when using the deposit pot's Deposit-Inventory or Deposit-Equipment buttons.
* The bone dagger's special attack now correctly guarantees a hit on Kephri when used on the first hit.
* Players can now attack again immediately after hitting Zebak's jugs with Magic, as with Ranged.
* Further refined Zebak's waves to stop the player from getting pushed closer to Zebak while attacking.
* Fixed a graphical issue where the Crondis room crocodiles would sporadically turn towards the player when pathing to the tree.
* The Wardens' skull bombs can no longer land underneath the Obelisk.

* Reduced the health of baboon shamans from 50 to 40 and cursed baboons from 30 to 20.
* Attacks made by thralls will no longer force the Arcane Scarab to move.

* Loot from the raid has been adjusted to reduce the rate of uniques entering the game; specifically, the overall unique chance for Raid Levels beyond 300 has been reduced. Additionally, at raid levels 350, 400, 450, and 500, the weighting of the lightbearer and Osmumten's fang reduces, while the weighting of other uniques increases.
* The deposit pot now functions identically to a bank deposit box.
* Drained stats are fully restored at the end of a boss fight.
* Smelling salts' boosts are reapplied upon expiring.
* Ba-Ba:
** Cursed Baboons and Baboon Shamans have had their Hitpoints increased, but will now always take max hit damage if using ranged attacks.
** Two waves of baboons have been removed from the Path of Apmeken room.
** Protect from Melee now fully protects the player from Ba-Ba's melee attack rather than reduce damage to 25%.
** The number of baboons that spawn during the Ba-Ba fight have been reduced from 1-8 to 1-4 based on group size, had their Hitpoints reduced from 35 to 10, and will now always take damage equal to the player's max hit. Additionally, they will spawn two banana peels on death if Jungle Japes is enabled.
** Damage from Ba-Ba's boulder throw attack is now always split completely with any appropriate object, including sarcophagi.
* Akkha:
** The Hitpoints on Het's Seal has been reduced so that one-downs no longer require boosting above 99 Mining.
** Protection prayers will now reduce more damage from Akkha's standard attacks.
** Akkha will now only pray against the combat style he's attacking with rather than using two prayers at once.
** Stat-drain effects now only apply to combat stats.
** Special attacks now occur every 7 attacks rather than 6.
** Unstable Orbs now spawn in fewer numbers.
** The Stay Vigilant invocation has been reworked:
*** Akkha will no longer randomly swap between attack styles and protection prayers, instead swapping whenever he uses a special attack.
*** Akkha will use special attacks every 6 attacks.
*** Akkha will no longer swap between styles randomly, instead using the same predictable order. Instead, he will only swap the style he's attacking with when he uses a special attack, provided he's used a standard attack since the last special attack.
* Kephri:
** The Soldier Scarab's magic defence has been reduced.
** The Defence level of Kephri's scarabs no longer scale with Raid Level.
** Arcane Scarabs will now always move after a certain number of attacks, even if they miss.
* Zebak:
** The amount of water required for the Palm of Resourcefulness no longer scales linearly with the number of players.
** Waves now have "smarter" interactions with pushback.
* Wardens:
** Lightning Skulls will no longer land underneath the Warden or the obelisk.
* Added a new reward - the Jewel of Amascut - which upgrades the keris partisan to the keris partisan of Amascut.
* The base drop rate of all jewels has increased from 1/180 to 1/50:
** This base rate still scales as before, meaning that the drop rate is ~1/16.67 at 75 raid completions.
** Having other jewels improves this rate further, meaning other jewels are obtained more often if the player has obtained one.
Logging out whilst in the Tombs of Amascut while having an escape crystal in your inventory will now consume the crystal and teleport you outside of the raid on login.
Players are no longer able to gain experience by using magic spells on the obelisks within the Path of Scarabas.

* The Baboon Mage, Baboon Brawler, and Baboon Thrower will now take damage equal to the player's maximum hit if hit with their opposing combat style. 
* Increased hitpoints of combat baboons, and significantly decreased hitpoints of special baboons. Additionally, their hitpoints are now static, rather than scaling based on raid level and group size.
* Ba-Ba's melee damage with Protect from Melee active has been reduced from 33% to 25%.
The Volatile Baboon's explosion attack will no longer kill pets.

poll: Awakened DT2 Bosses & Poll 80
change:
* A deposit pot has been added in the nexus, next to where the Helpful Spirit would be, where players can deposit their items into the bank from within the raid.
* A cavity has been added in the raid lobby where players can deposit and retrieve their pickaxe from the statue inside the Path of Het challenge room.
* The Path of Apmeken has been adjusted to allow players to clear the baboon waves quicker:
** The minimum and maximum amount of baboons for most waves have been increased, meaning fewer baboons must be killed before the next wave begins.
** A Volatile Baboon's explosion attack can now hit other baboons.
** Baboon Shamans are now vulnerable to poison and venom, and being inflicted with either will also now cause them to stop summoning Baboon Thralls and switch to magic attacks.
* Akkha, during his enrage phase, will now teleport after a certain number of successful hits from the player themselves, rather than a fixed number of hits that previously included missed hits and thrall damage.
* A number of invocations have had their descriptions updated to be clearer.
A bug was fixed in the Tombs of Amascut where freezing a Warden just as it was waking up would remove it from existence.
Party leaders in the Tombs of Amascut can now promote other members of the party while the group is forming in the lobby.
Mapping issues within 'purgatory' of the Crondis room have been corrected.
Combat Achievements were added for the raid.

* It is no longer possible to smuggle additional mirrors between phases in the Path of Het challenge room.
* Players can no longer receive the 'Leech' title if they have the highest damage, or are the raid MVP.

* An issue was fixed in which the corner tiles of the puzzles within the Path of Scabaras were difficult to step on when the camera was facing east.
* Using the escape crystal on another player in the raid no longer consumes two crystals.

* The Akkha and the Warden fights should now be back to normal after the previous update's code optimisation caused various issues.
* Various potions, when dropped within the raid, will now appear immediately for other party members.
* The reward interface has been slightly adjusted to look better.
* Energy Siphons should no longer be misaligned in parties of two or more.
* Players can no longer stand on a certain tile in the waters during the fight with Zebak.
* Players who inadvertently stand in the void upon the end of the raid should no longer be prevented from leaving the room.

* A safespot unintentionally added during the third phase of the Wardens fight, where players can avoid the floor slam attacks entirely, has been removed.
* The supplies' "Withdraw 1" option no longer withdraws all the items.

* The Wardens:

* Other:

change:
* The Wardens:
** The raid timer now ends when the Warden reaches 0 health, rather than when the death animation ends.

* Supplies:

poll: Poll 83 - Castle Wars, New Player Changes & More
change:
A number of changes and quality of life updates was added to the Castle Wars minigame.

Dedicated Castle Wars world changes:

* You can now only enter through the Guthix (green) portal to ensure more balanced teams.
* Players will now earn 1 additional Castle wars ticket for participating in a game.

All Castle Wars world changes:

* The Castlewars brew now also applies the effects of a stamina potion and super restore when consumed. 
** However, the reduction in run energy depletion associated with stamina potions does not occur on free-to-play worlds.
* Helmets can now be worn in Castle Wars.
* Bandages now scale with your Hitpoints level and can overheal, similar to members-only anglerfish.
** With 99 Hitpoints and a Castle Wars bracelet charge, the bandages can heal up to 27.
* Castle Wars bracelets can now be handed to Lanthus to store charges, automatically consuming one per game.
** Noted bracelets are also accepted, allowing to store a specific number of noted items.
* Players now receive a rune pouch when entering Castle Wars, providing unlimited runes for selected spells. 
** These spells do not grant Magic experience when cast. To earn full Magic experience, players must provide their own runes.
** On free-to-play worlds, the spells include all strikes, bolts, and blasts, as well as binding spells such as Bind and Snare.
* A new barricade cap on dedicated Castle Wars worlds restricts teams to 7 barricades outside and 10 inside the base.
* Barricades placed now have a coloured rope to indicate what team they belong to.
* Barricades can now be placed in front of the respawn barriers.
* A new element has been added to the Castle Wars Heads-Up Display, showing the number of barricades your team has placed both inside and outside your base.
* Small walls have been added to the stairs and ladder at the respawn point, allowing players to range over them and create more strategic barricade placements.
* There is now a table with buckets in the supply room where the bucket spawn used to be.
* Fixed a bug where the player's overhead yellow arrow would not disappear after depositing the flag.

Run energy depletion and regeneration rates were improved on all Agility levels including 1. Since the energy drain rate is now dependent on the Agility level, this further increases the advantage that accounts trained on the members-only worlds can have over pure free-to-play accounts.

* The minimum hit has been increased from 0 to 1, slightly increasing the average DPS. Every successful accuracy roll now results in at least 1 damage.
* The damage of the air, water, and earth elemental spells including strikes, bolts, and blasts now scales up to 8, 12, or 16 respectively, matching the strongest unlocked spell in the tier. As such, Wind Blast should now be preferred over Fire Blast in PvP scenarios due to a lower cast cost.
* Mystic Lore and Mystic Might now increase magic damage by 1% and 2% respectively. However, with no other magic damage bonuses available in free-to-play worlds, they have no effect on the maximum magic damage.
* Prayer points drain rate of Thick Skin, Burst of Strength, Clarity of Thought, Sharp Eye, and Mystic Will was decreased from 5 to 1.67 points per minute. Effectively, they should drain at a third of the speed they used to.
* Sharp Eye and Burst of Strength now boost the Ranged and Strength by at least 1 level respectively, even if those levels are lower than 20.
* Attacking an NPC with the auto-cast enabled no longer incurs an extra 1 tick (0.6s) delay.

* Raw food no longer appears to other players when dropped in the Wilderness. This prevents players from being able to transfer food mid-fight by cooking the picked up raw food.
* Manually dropped food and potions now despawn faster in the Wilderness to prevent from stacking extra supplies prior to the fights and juggling the items during combat. 
* Aggression range of the selected Wilderness monsters including Ankou, Lesser Demons, Ice Giants, and Hill Giants was modified.
* Unintended PJ timer interactions across single-way and multi-way combat borders were removed. This prevents from situations where a player exiting a multi-way combat area might have been safe from attacks if they attacked a different opponent that the last one that have hit them while still in the multi-way combat zone.
* A bridge over the lava just south of the Wilderness Chaos Temple was added, yielding much faster access to the altar when approaching from the south.
* A zombie pirate ship was added to the eastern shore of the Wilderness. It has little use in the free-to-play worlds, since the lockers cannot be opened, but the ladder there can possibly be used to escape a PKer when running from locations such as the nature runes spawn or the Demonic Ruins.
Previous PvP combat information is now wiped upon death. This prevents players who have just died from coming back to fight their opponent again without being skulled.
A Loot Chest has been added to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard on the PvP worlds.
Bryophyta's staff is a now a free-to-play item, becoming the best-in-slot free-to-play magic weapon with magic accuracy and defence bonuses at +15.
Players can no longer trade in the Wilderness if they are or recently were in combat, which prevents from transferring supplies mid-fight.

* PJ timer was increased within the single-way combat areas of the Wilderness. Combat interruption prevention was added. This significantly affected multiplayer activities in and near single-way combat areas, and made techniques such as boxing or PJing obsolete.
* Loot Chests were added to the Grand Exchange and the Edgeville bank, significantly increasing their utility on the free-to-play worlds.
* The cost of unlocking the loot keys was decreased from 5,000,000 coins to 1,000,000 coins.

Loot keys were introduced as an opt-in feature. Players can unlock the option to enable loot keys by paying 5,000,000 coins to Skully. When enabled, items dropped by opponents killed by the player are not dropped into the ground, and the player receives a loot key instead. The loot can be retrieved from the loot chest in the Ferox Enclave. Players can hold up to 5 keys, and can modify whether food and other supplies or valuable items are stored in the loot chest or not. Due to the lack of reliable transportation methods to the Ferox Enclave, the utility of the loot keys remained limited to the areas around the enclave itself, as well as the deep Wilderness.

The defence bonuses of the items from the green dragonhide armour set and its trimmed variants were significantly lowered. Note that the gilded dragonhide armour was unaffected, becoming the best-in-slot ranged equipment in terms of defensive capabilities.
The clan system was overhauled and fully launched. The classic clan chats are now available as chat-channels.

update: Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One
change:
* Warhammer wielding requirements were changed from Attack to the equivalent Strength levels.
* The strength bonuses of warhammers were significantly increased. Now they are slightly lower than the bonuses of the battleaxes from the same materials.
* Maces are now 1 tick faster, matching the speed of the scimitars.
* Ranged accuracy penalty was removed from medium helmets and square shields.
* Ranged accuracy penalty of the full helmets, kiteshields, platelegs, plateskirts and platebodies was increased by roughly 50%.

This update made strength pures a viable build common among low level players.

update: Settings Rework and the last of Poll 73
change:
* Full helmets were introduced to the decorative armours from the Castle Wars rewards shop. They has equivalent bonuses to the steel, mithril and adamant helmets respectively.
* Red, white, and  gold decorative boots with bonuses equivalent to the steel, mithril, and adamant boots respectively were introduced to the Castle Wars Ticket Exchange. With notable melee defence bonuses, they became the best items in the footwear slot. In particular, gold decorative boots offer the highest melee defensive bonuses, as well as strength bonus of +1, which increased maximum melee hit of some weapons such as the rune scimitar (from 25 to 26).
* Castlewars brew was introduced to the Castle Wars minigame, significantly increasing maximum hits of melee and ranged weapons. Combined with the Castle wars bracelet, it allows to achieve the highest possible hits and DPS values within the free-to-play worlds.
The Ferox Enclave respawn can now be unlocked and used by the free-to-play players by paying 5,000,000 coins to Ferox.

The Ferox Enclave was introduced to the Wilderness. It is the first settlement with a bank within the free-to-play Wilderness bounds. The town now contains the lobbies of the Clan Wars and the Last Man Standing minigames that were moved there from Al Kharid, as well as a portal to the Castle Wars lobby. Notable features also include the Pool of Refreshment that can heal players' hitpoints, prayer points, run energy and skill changes.

update: PvP Balancing, LMS, and Elf Graphics
change:
* The Snare spell was added to the free-to-play worlds.
* The binding duration of the Bind and Snare spells is no longer halved by the Protect from Magic prayer.

* The Tele Block spell was added to the free-to-play worlds.
* The skull status is no longer removed upon entering Clan Wars.

update: Runes and Ammunition & Log In Screen Competition!
change: Players can now toggle whether the arrows are placed in the inventory or automatically added to the ammunition slot upon picking up by talking to the ranged combat tutor.

Castle wars bracelet can now be traded on free-to-play worlds, which increased the viability of the Castle Wars minigame for training by significantly increasing the DPS as well as the number of hitpoints healed by the bandages.

* The Castle Wars minigame was added to the free-to-play worlds. At the time, players could get there by a portal located in Al Kharid next to the Clan Wars lobby.
* Some Castle Wars rewards including melee decorative armour were introduced to free-to-play.
* Zamorak monk robes were added to the free-to-play worlds as uncommon drops from the monks of Zamorak. In particular, Zamorak monk bottom is the only free-to-play item in the legs slot with a magic accuracy bonus, surpassing the leather chaps as the best legs armour for magic combat.
The free-to-play mode was permanently added to the Old School RuneScape.

poll: Old School Wilderness Feedback Poll
change: Rune god armour now gives a +1 prayer bonus per piece, becoming the best-in-slot melee equipment surpassing regular and gilded rune armour.
The Edgeville respawn can be unlocked by paying 5,000,000 coins to Krystilia and now works on free-to-play style worlds.
"F2p-style" worlds were added for subscribers that wished to play without the members' features.

update: Changes to Sailing & LMS Rewards Eligibility
change:
* Players must first win a game of Last Man Standing before they can purchase any tradeable items from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing. Players who have not won any games can only purchase the untradeable items from the shop.
* If a player dies without having been in combat with another player within the last 30 seconds, their death will be treated as a PvM death instead of a PvP death - even if they were attacked by another player earlier. This applies to all account types. If the player was not in player combat in the last 30 seconds before dying, the PKer can no longer receive the loot, and the lost items can be reclaimed from a Grave or Death. Otherwise, standard PvP death mechanics will apply.
Giant easter egg no longer causes players to stall on PvP worlds.

* An axe can now be stored at the canoe stations, saving an inventory slot when travelling to the deep Wilderness by a canoe.
* Applied tweaks to the Last Man Standing minigame:
** Increased the timer before a game is forcefully ended to 20 minutes, up from 16 minutes 15 seconds.
** Venom effect from the noxious halberd and burn effect from the eclipse set are now cleared from the player's character when they win a fight.
** Players can now hold up to 2 sanfew serums in their setups, rather than just 1.
** Point awards were increased in the ranked mode (unavailable in the free-to-play worlds).

update: More Doom Tweaks, Poll 84, & Summer Sweep Up Changes
change: Wilderness loot key interface now matches the Deadman mode style. Loot chest can be opened without consuming a loot key, allowing for partial removal of the content without removing the loot key from the inventory.

A new category was added to the "Report Abuse" menu: "PvP Cheating". This may be used when someone is suspected of cheating while partaking in PvP activities, including through the use of macroing software.

update: Guardians of the Rift Changes Out Now!
change:
* Loot keys containing less than 1,000,000 coins worth of loot can now be destroyed in unsafe areas, up from 30,000 coins.
* Players that are in combat in a multicombat area can now retaliate if attacked by a player in a single-way combat area.

update: Varlamore: The Rising Darkness is OUT NOW
change: A new "Energy threshold to re-enable running" setting was added. When set to a non-zero value, it will re-enable run after the player runs out of energy and then regenerates it to a specified threshold.

* Legacy Duels at the Emir's Arena are now restricted to the specific 'Legacy Duels' worlds.
* Worlds 483 (east United States) and 571 (Australia) were marked as the designated Legacy Duels servers in addition to the existing world 379 (United Kingdom).
The "Classic F2P" option was added to the "Magic" dropdown in the Clan Wars options with Bind being the only available freeze spell. This allows organizing PvP events with Snare being disabled.

* Players may now own an unlimited number of fancy boots and fighting boots, including both at once.
* Players who have a Jagex Account can now obtain fancier boots from the Cradle of Life with identical bonuses to both fancy and fighting boots.
* All 3 types of boots rewarded from the Stronghold of Security are longer destroyed on death, and instead they are sent to the gravestone upon death below the 20 level of the Wilderness. They are now about as convenient to use as regular boots, which makes them a viable option for low Defence pures, especially at lower levels to counter low Attack opponents.

The cursed goblin hammer now has -100 melee accuracy bonuses, making the player wielding it always hit a 0 on their targets. This allows free boxing without the possibility to damage the target, locking both players in combat in single-way areas.

Bind and Snare now yield varying amounts of Magic experience depending on whether the projectile hits or splashes:
* For Bind, a success now gives 31 XP, up from 30.
* For Snare, a success now gives 61 XP (plus optional damage), up from 60.
Canifis boots are now tradeable on the free-to-play worlds similarly to the gloves. They offer the same bonuses as the leather boots.

* NPCs attacking the players within PvP areas now work under a shorter 5 second PJ timer instead of the full 12 second grace period, matching the behaviour from before the PJ timer increase.
* One-defence pure and zerker modes were added to the Last Man Standing minigame.

An optional golden trim for hitsplats was added. The trim is displayed when players deal their maximum hits in combat with the current weapon or spell and attack style. In free-to-play, the trim works for all combat styles including melee, ranged, and magic. It shows up both when the player deals maximum damage to an opponent, or if an opponent deals their maximum damage to the player. The effect is purely cosmetic and can be turned off in the settings.
Duel Arena was replaced with the Emir's Arena. Players are still able to challenge each other for safe PvP duels in the legacy mode, but coins can no longer be staked in fights.

Barronite mace was introduced as a reward from the activities within the Ruins of Camdozaal. With its 4-tick speed, crush-based attack, a strength bonus of +40 and a prayer bonus of +2, this mace can be an effective alternative to the rune scimitar.

The competitive mode of the Last Man Standing minigame can no longer be played on the free-to-play worlds, preventing free-to-play players from earning the reward points. A new map based on 4th Age Varrock was introduced.

The Last Man Standing minigame was overhauled. The Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing shop was introduced with notable free-to-play rewards including the swift blade, a 1-handed 3-tick melee weapon with no combat bonuses. The items from the shop can be bought with points earned through the competitive mode of the minigame.

Treasure Trails were expanded with a wide range of new decorative free-to-play items such as gilded dragonhide armour, ham joint, amulet of power (t), trimmed monk's robes, heraldic platebodies, gold-trimmed leather armour and rune scimitar ornament kits. While at the time of release a vast majority of the new rewards provided equal bonuses to the existing items, they can be useful for risk fighting.

Obor was introduced as the first free-to-play boss with the hill giant club as a rare drop. The club provides the same strength bonus as a rune 2h sword and similar accuracy bonuses, but uses crush instead of slash attacks, which makes it more accurate against players wearing plate armour.
The Last Man Standing minigame was added. At the time, the lobby of the minigame was located at Al Kharid, near the Clan Wars lobby.

update: Guardians of the Rift Changes Out Now!
poll: Poll 82 - Minigame Changes
change:
A number of changes have been made to the minigame:
* The minigame no longer has a player cap and instead scales with the number of participants, with players being able to freely join and leave if there are at least 100 participants.
* To account for leeches in bigger teams, every player beyond the 20th grants a 20% scaling penalty on the charge required to power up the Great Guardian.
* Players can now build weak barriers and assemble weak guardians before the game begins by using uncharged cells, though this does not give any experience.
* The first two cycles of portal guardians that open up are now guaranteed to be medium-tier or higher.
* The table of uncharged cells has had the order of interactions changed.
* Players can now recharge barriers even at full health, capping at 2,500 Runecraft experience and 450 energy per game.
* Repairing a cell tile now requires 12 guardian fragments instead of 10 guardian essence.
* The rewards guardian has been given a "Big-Search" option to loot it five times in one go, as well as sacrifice 25 abyssal pearls for an additional loot roll.
* The amount of abyssal pearls received when rolled has been changed from 10-20 to 14-16.
* The colossal pouch no longer requires 85 Runecraft to use, with the storage capacity now scaled based on which essence pouches the player can currently use.

* The barrier has been made more red when players are unable to enter the minigame.
* A red, eye open variant has been added, indicating the player count has reached 200 but the game has not yet started.
Players in the Guardians of the Rift will no longer get Mining experience beyond the first 250 guardian fragments mined per game.
Players can no longer kill Apprentice Tamara during the Guardians of the Rift minigame.

update: Forestry: The Way of the Forester - Part One
change:
* A permanent chisel spawn has been added south-east of the cell tables, directly between the red dark laces.
* A "Repair" option has been added on Apprentice Cordelia to quickly repair essence pouches, providing the player has unlocked the ability to do so via her.
Players can now purchase an abyssal lantern from Apprentice Felix via dialogue for 1,500 abyssal pearls.
Worlds 425 (Australia), 441 (US West) & 459 (EU) will now become additional theme worlds for Guardians of the Rift.
Essence Pouches have been added to the minigame's loot table.
Two new official worlds have been designated for the minigame: 490 for United States (east) and 507 for United Kingdom

* The amount of players that can join a game has been increased from 100 to 200.
* Players seeking to play in smaller groups can now speak to Apprentice Tamara to lock down the barrier once the first stage of the game begins; this cannot be done on official worlds, and players must have Tamara re-lock the barrier each time a game ends.
* A brief period of time has been added upon the Great Guardian reaching 100% power to allow players to hand in their excess guardian stones before the game ends.
* Multiple rift guardians can now be simultaneously made from one essence pile, and the time it takes to create one has been reduced.
* The "Inspect" option from cell barriers has been removed, and the length of their health bars have been halved. In addition, they will always display their health bars if not full.
It is no longer possible to cast Alchemy spells inside.
The official worlds 571 and 576 have been switched with 464 (Germany) and 534 (Australia).

* Crafting combination runes will now give polyelemental guardian stones instead of elemental guardian stones. As a result, the bug in which the Raiments of the Eye provided extra elemental guardian stones when crafting combination runes has been fixed.
* Abyssal lanterns and dyes can be exchanged with Apprentice Felix for 100 and 50 abyssal pearls, respectively.
* Placing cells on an empty cell tile now gives 17-30 of each energy (depending on the type of cell used) rather than 2.
* Repairing a broken cell tile now gives 25 of each energy rather than 10.
* Cells can now be upgraded at a runic altar, without having to drop weaker cells to acquire a better charged cell.
* The Deposit Pool now has "Deposit-runes" as its left-click option.
* Destroy options have been reinstated for guardian fragments and stones.
* Guardians of the Rift completions have been added to the HiScores.
* Portal Guardians will no longer appear active during the starting phase.
Two new official worlds have been designated for the minigame: 571 for Australia and 576 for United States (east), both being free-to-play worlds.

* Timers have been added to the minigame UI for when the first phase ends, when the active Portal Guardians will change, and when the shortcut portals close.
* Official worlds have been dedicated for the minigame: 445 for the United States (west) and 522 for the United Kingdom.
* Prices for the Raiments of the Eye have been reduced. Players who purchased them before this update will find upon login that the difference in abyssal pearls have been refunded to their bank, their inventory if the bank is full, or on the ground if both are full.
* The entry barrier now has "Quick-pass" option, and will appear red with the eye closed when a game is ongoing. Players can also toggle the visual effects that occur when using portals off or on via the barrier.
* Gameplay items now have a "Drop" option rather than "Destroy".
* The superior cell will now be prioritised when two players are attempting to assemble a rift guardian with differently charged cells.
* The rubble leading to the large guardian remains now has a "Climb" option rather than "Climb-down".
* Portals to the huge guardian fragment mine will no longer spawn to the north due to players being prone to misclick objects around it.

update: Guardians of the Rift Feedback Changes
change:
* The amount of players that can join a game has been increased from 60 to 100.
* Players can now enter the game during the first phase.
* Charged cells can now be used on barriers with full health for contribution.
* The drop rate of abyssal pearls have been increased by 15%.
* Points cap has been increased from 1,000 to 1,200.
* Cells now 'heal' full-health barriers, giving extra contribution points but not Runecraft XP.

update: Guardians of the Rift Feedback Changes

change: The Dragon Grandmaster rank upper limit has been increased from 9,999 to 15,000. The Fake [[File:Egg.png]] rank is no longer shown.

* The matchmaking system has been adjusted to ensure that matches occur more frequently.

update: New Client Update: Clue Scroll Helper
change:
* When outside combat areas on PvP Arena worlds, the "Trade" option has been replaced with a "Load-outs" option. Players can right-click another player and open a menu showing the selected player's three loadouts. From here, you can copy their loadout over to yours, replacing your current preset.
* The grouping algorithm has been rebalanced to help the less common ranks find matches.

* The Bow of Faerdhinen has been removed from the PvP Arena Supplies interface.
* Right-clicking the rune pouch within the supplies interface will now allow players to choose what runes are brought into a fight.
* A button to copy the opponent's loadout has been added for unranked fights.
* The Elo system has been adjusted to address the way that rank points scale in uneven fights:
** Players winning against weaker opponents will gain fewer rank points
** Players winning against stronger opponents will gain more rank points
** Players losing against stronger opponents will lose fewer rank points
** Players losing against weaker opponents will lose more rank points
* The price for a scroll of imbuing has been reduced from 500 points to 200. Players who purchased one prior to this update will be refunded their points.

* The Emir's Arena was fully launched. Rank and reward points earned during the soft launch were reset to 0.
* Several items were added and removed from the PvP Arena Supplies interface:
** Players will no longer see items that their designated build cannot equip. As such, the Ghrazi rapier and Inquisitor's mace have been removed from the interface (as no build can currently equip them).
** Xerician robes, rune gloves, the amulet of blood fury, and the Zaryte crossbow have been added.
** Purple sweets, the ring of suffering (i), and the ancient godsword have been removed, as they were deemed too powerful.
** Heavy ballista and Ava's assembler can no longer be equipped by 1 Def Pure builds.
** Elite Void Knight equipment can no longer be equipped by Zerker builds.
* The timer before a tournament starts has been reduced from 8:30 minutes to 5 minutes.
* Tournaments will automatically begin if no new players enter the staging area for over 72 seconds.
* Players in the staging area will now receive chatbox messages to indicate that the tournament is ready to begin.
* The info button to check brackets during a tournament battle is now hidden during combat.
* The size of the timer during a fight has been reduced.
* A chatbox message has been added during unranked fights to indicate Rank and Reward Points will not be earned.
* Health bars visible to spectators via telescopes now have a secondary layer that drains after a short delay, like a typical fighting game.
The Emir's Arena was soft-launched for testing in order to test the core systems used in the minigame.

change: Duke Sucellus no longer remains poisoned from one fight to the next.

poll: Sailing Buffs, Changes & More
change:

* Boat combat:
** Added the bosun's workbench, a facility that lets crewmates automatically repair your ship.
** Added chainshot cannonballs and incendiary cannonballs.
** Added an auto-retaliate setting for cannons when your boat is attacked by enemies at sea.
* Deep sea trawling:
** Sailing XP from Deep Sea Trawling has been buffed, now giving roughly double the XP compared to before:
*** XP from Rope trawling net has been increased from 4 XP to 7 XP
*** XP from Linen trawling net has been increased from 5 XP to 9 XP
*** XP from Hemp trawling net has been increased from 6 XP to 11 XP
*** XP from Cotton trawling net has been increased from 8 XP to 15 XP
** Reduced your character's gather rate from 4 ticks to 3 ticks.
