update: Sailing Changes and Gem Bag Expansion
change:
* Mapped various solo spawns of high-level seaborne creatures, such as Vampyre Krakens, Armoured Krakens and Great White Sharks.
* The drop rates of Clue Scrolls from Sailing creatures are now buffed by ~5% for those who completed the relevant Combat Achievements tier.
* In the Shipyard, you can now use the side panel to move the facilities up or down the menu. This lets you customise the menu layout for you (and your player passengers) when you're on board.
* Created a distinction between boostable facility types as 'Active' and 'Support' facilities.
** Active facilities will always ask you to meet the required Sailing level to use. These include cannons, salvaging hooks, trawling nets, and chum stations.
** Support facilities can be permanently used once built via boost, without needing to reboost your Sailing level. These include the cargo hold, range, keg, salvaging station, anchor, fathom stone/pearl, wind/gale catcher, and crystal extractor.
** Captains can keep using boosted-built sails, but other players must still meet the level requirement.
* Added extra functionality to the 'Special Attack' button whilst you're on a boat (and attached to the Helm), allowing you to release Wind Motes.
* Sorting any salvage now has a small chance of dropping the Sailing pet, Soup.
* Fish gained from Deep Sea Trawling (giant krill, haddock, yellowfin, halibut, marlin, and bluefin) will now appear more vibrant when cooked.
* The lighting of coral patches was slightly adjusted to be brighter.
* Sailing items are now unblocked from Death's Coffer as their prices have now stabilised.
* The Boat Bottle indicator no longer gets hidden in the Shipyard interface.
* The Facility Bottle will now correctly ask if you want to discard the contents of your Cargo Hold if you choose to modify it on a raft.
* Fixed a bug where lighting a fire with a Shortbow using Rosewood, Ironwood and Camphor logs was giving more XP than with a Tinderbox.
* Fixed a bug that caused boat customisation to fail when a player had only one boat with a Greater Teleport Focus and summoned it to a port.

* The herb sack, seed box, and rune pouch now all work with looting Sailing creatures. Note that for this to work:
** The herb sack and seed box must be open.
** The "Rune-picking behaviour" option in the Settings must be enabled.
* Added a new NPC called Isles, who can be found wandering outside the bank at Port Roberts. If you've sailed to Grimstone before, speak to Isles and invite him to accompany you there on your boat. Once you enter the Grimstone Dungeon, he'll become available at the Ancient Furnace. There, he can unnote any metal bar that's used for making cannonballs, charging 100 coins per note.
* Casting Telekinetic Grab on defeated seaborne creatures now lets you collect their loot while remaining engaged to the cannon, or to similar facilities.
* The Telekinetic Grab spell now works on lost crates too, provided you have the required Sailing level and some space for the crates' contents.

* Cannons have been buffed when they are actively manned by a player, ensuring that a player using a cannon is on par to the DPS of traditional combat +2 crew members using cannons.
* The hitpoints of some sea creatures has been reduced.
* Bounty task experience has been reduced by 25%.
* Ranged modifiers such as the void armour effect and Ranged Prayers now apply in cannon combat.
* Worn Ranged gear will now correctly apply its stats to the overall damage.

poll: The Winter Summit Poll
change:
* Boat combat:
** Cannons have been rebalanced. They now shoot slower than before, but hit harder.
** You can now build two cannons on the same side of your Sloop.
** Players can now build a ballistic attractor, which is a facility that retrieve 60% of the cannonballs used.
** Two extra facility slots have been added to the Sloop (which can be used for cannons or the ballistic attractor).
** Traditional combat using player gear now works the same on sea creatures as it does on land; previously, there was a damage reduction mechanic. Sea creatures have had their HP adjusted accordingly.
** Removed the delay in looting sea creatures. You can now use Telekinetic Grab to instantly loot a sea monster corpse with no net animation.
** A 'Fire At Will' Mode has been added to the Sailing side panel, allowing your crew to hit sea creatures in range automatically.
** We've buffed the amount of cannonballs that can be received from Cannonball Thieving, Shipwreck Salvaging and various NPCs.
** Enemy attacks will no longer interrupt most Captain actions, so you can continue to use interfaces or other menus without them forcibly closing.
** A new NPC, the veiled kraken, has been added to the Tangled Kelp alongside two new Bounty Tasks to hunt it down. Unique drops include the Dragon Cannon Barrel and Inky Paint.
* Other:
** Fixed a bug where the invisible +2 Sailing boost for the Keg of Whirlpool Surprise was not applying in certain situations.
** Fixed an animation bug with 1.5 tick shipwreck salvaging.
** Players can now use a filled fish crate on a bank booth, banker, or bank chest to empty the fish into their inventory.
** Fixed an issue where the message shown when attempting to create Adamant keel parts incorrectly stated the required Smithing level.

update: More from the Getting Around Poll
change:
* Adjusted the placement of ocean rapids to better align with popular routes players have been using for cargo deliveries.
* Crewmate and salvaging hook animations now play without delay when a crewmate is assigned to the salvaging hook while sailing toward a shipwreck.
Resolved an inconsistency where speed boost durations were shorter when sails were trimmed by a crewmate instead of the player.
The captain of a boat can now trim all sails, regardless of their Sailing level. This is to allow players to use their sails if they had boosted their Sailing level to build them.

* Players now require a Sailing level to trim sails, which is the same level required as to build the sail.
* Crewmates now operate facilities such as the helm, trawler net and salvaging hook only if the player has the required level for them - not based on crewmate stats.

* Fixed an issue where boats could be summoned without a teleport focus if one had previously been built on the boat.
* Fixed an issue where boats could get stuck in certain positions near the Brimhaven port.
* The correct player's RSN is now shown on all messaging boxes of the Navigation Permissions, including the cargo hold access message.
* The camera starts now panning without delay when using the telescope at the Piscarilius food hall.
* Reduced the number of sharks around Mermaid locations, including in multi-combat zones like north of Crash Island.
* If your helm's covered in crystals when you order your crew to operate it, the game will now recognise immediately that they can't do it, instead of waiting until the crew reaches the helm before giving the feedback.
* The wandering pirate NPC boat no longer crashes into the rocks and gets stuck.

* Group Ironmen can now use facilities on their group members' ships regardless of whether or not they've built that facility themselves, so long as they have the Sailing level required.
* The bonecrusher and bonecrusher necklace now work for any Sailing creatures who drop bones.
* When quick-transporting your boat (e.g. recovering via a shipwright or using a boat spell), players will now only lose Port Task cargo, Bounty items, salvage and fish from their Cargo Hold.
* Cargo crates are now confiscated immediately when you teleport while carrying them.
* The "Start the boat when setting a heading" option now works more reliably for players whose crewmates were already controlling the helm when they boarded the boat.
* The following Sailing activities can now be boosted:
** All sea charting types
** Both building and using cannons on a boat
* Updated the requirement met filter in the Sea Charting interface to include quest requirements.
* Testing the currents south of the pest-filled island near the Void Knight's Outpost is now correctly listed under The Simian Sea.
* Fixed a spade-related typo on the Port Task board.
* Added an option to disable teleport warnings while on a boat.

* Experience rewards like lamps and Tears of Guthix can now be used on Sailing.
* Players should no longer find themselves logging in at the last port that they visited if they logged out with their boat docked at an island's mooring point.
* Removed some invisible walls in the Fremensund near Meaty Aura Logist.
* Default settings have been adjusted so that using the 'Check Materials' button on boat upgrades will display a message in chat by default.
* Players can no longer walk onto 'sailable' tiles in Varlamore and Laguna Aurorae and teleport themselves to Port Sarim.
* Planks from the Plank Sack are now useable when building facilities on a boat.

* Fixed a collision logic issue that led to a lot of issues with boats becoming stuck.
* Added an option to the settings menu to allow players to determine who can use their cargo hold, separate and independent from who is allowed on your boat.
* It is now no longer possible to trim the sails while wielding cargo.
* Bounty tasks now correctly match the required Sailing level for their NPC locations.
* The materials list has been corrected for the teleport focus and the rune salvaging hook in the skill guide.
* Fixed an issue where the camera would sometimes hide in a corner when joining a friend's boat.
* Fixed an issue where repair kits weren't updating the ship's HP in the Sailing side-panel.

update: Undead Pirates Tweaks, Varlamore CAs & More
change:
* Combat Achievements have been added for the Fortis Colosseum.
* Molten sand no longer deals damage between waves.

A number of changes has been made to the Colosseum's modifiers:
* Bees!:
** The time between the Bee Swarm's movements has been increased from 7 ticks (4.2s) to 12 ticks (7.2s).
** The respawn delay has been increased from 18 ticks (10.8s) to 50 ticks (30s).
* Doom:
** Doom is now a stackable modifier, now killing the player at 15, 10, or 5 stacks of doom depending on tier.
** Self-damaging items will no longer apply doom.
** Doom stacks are now removed at the end of a wave, rather than being permanent for a run.
* Totemic:
** The healing totem's respawn timer has been increased from 1 minute to 2 minutes.
** The totem's healing has been reduced from 40% to 30% of the targeted NPC's health.
* Self-damaging items will no longer drain prayer points if Blasphemy is active.
* The Doom Scorpion has been removed, with a new modifier named Mantimayhem taking its place.
* Myopia will now affect autocasted spells, though manually casting them is unaffected.
* Relentless now ignores a percentage of the player's Defence level, with tier 3 being unchanged.

In addition:
* Unique drops are now available starting on the 3rd wave.
* The following items have had their rates adjusted on the unique drop table:
** Sunfire fanatic armour has been adjusted from 3/10 to 9/16.
** Echo crystal has been adjusted from 6/10 to 6/16.
** Tonalztics of Ralos has been adjusted from 1/10 to 1/16, and is made exclusive from wave 7 onwards.
* Special attack energy no longer regenerates between waves in the Colosseum.

* The Fremennik warband archer's ranged bonuses has been increased.
* The fremennik warband berserker's strength bonus has been reduced.
* The amount of Glory awarded has been corrected for stacked modifiers.
* NPCs will no longer occasionally appear by the arena seats.
* All opponents within now have the full attack style information when using the Monster Examine spell; for example, Melee will now appear as Stab.
* Reduced the amount of Sunfire splinters from wave 1, and increased the amount rewarded from waves 9-12.

* The description of the Doom modifier has been updated to state that any damage taken applies the debuff rather than damage taken that wasn't protected with prayer.
* The description of the Myopia modifier was updated.

* The track now plays in a combined area with all main Isafdar music tracks

* Task fixes:
** The "Activate an Arcane or Dexterous Scroll" task has been fixed for players without the Grimoire. You can now complete it by simply reading an Arcane or Dexterous Scroll.
** The chatbox closing prematurely no longer blocks the "Activate the Statue of Ates" task. If you've already met the requirements but the task wasn't registered, the task will be retroactively completed for you when opening the areas, relics or masteries interface from the Leagues V menu.
** Obtaining the Quetzin now completes the task "Obtain a skilling pet", as intended. For players who have already unlocked the Quetzin pet, the task will retroactively complete upon opening the areas, relics, or masteries interface.
** The "Equip a Full God Dragonhide Set" task can now be completed with Zamorakian dragonhide armour.
** The "Brutally Murder Conrad King" task will now be auto-completed when you unlock Kourend and Kebos. If you've already unlocked Kourend and Kebos, the task will retroactively complete upon opening the areas, relics, or masteries interface.
** The "Garden of Death" task will now be auto-completed when you unlock the Desert. If you've already unlocked the Desert, the task will be retroactively completed for you when opening the areas, relics, or masteries interface from the Leagues V Menu.
** Echo boss kills now count towards the Kill Count tasks of Combat Achievements. If you've already done the full amount of KC, it will be retroactively completed after an additional KC.
** Echoes from the melee mastery no longer fail the tasks to kill bosses with specific weapons. Additionally, echoes no longer affect non-melee Nylocas in Theatre of Blood.
** Corrected the text on the “Have Elsie tell you a story” task description to state that she lives in Varrock, not Falador.
** Corrected the description of the "Steal 15 Artefacts" task.
* The following clue steps can now be completed if you have Treasure Arbiter unlocked:
** Talk to Robin with 180+ Ranged Attack.
** Talk to Ghommal with 100+ Strength bonus.
** Talk to Juna whilst wearing three Guthix items.
** Anger emote at the Saradomin statue in Varrock with a Zamorak Godsword.(No longer requires Zamorak Godsword, but you'll still need to have the Saradomin statue installed)
** Do a jig at the Barrows chest whilst wearing a set of Barrows.
** Yawn at Pyramid Plunder whilst wearing a Pharaoh's Sceptre.
** Dance in Iban's temple whilst wearing an Iban's Staff, Mystic Robe Top, and Mystic Robe Bottom.
* Other clue step fixes:
** The "Equip Iban's Staff" clue step will now only appear if you have Tirannwn, Kandarin and Morytania areas unlocked.
** Fixed a bug where the elite clue step "Panic at the area flowers meet snow" was showing up despite not having Kandarin unlocked.
** Using the anger emote with the Treasure Arbiter Relic unlocked now correctly makes the Double Agent appear.
* Relic fixes:
** Production Master now works when crafting with amethyst.
** Checking experience is now correctly given when a fruit tree is replanted with Overgrown.
** big shark, big swordfish and big bass can no longer be auto-cooked with the Animal Wrangler relic.
** Specialist relic fix: special attack energy now restores when killing a lost soul during The Whisperer fight.
** Fixed an issue where the Clue Compass teleport to Keldagrim required completing The Giant Dwarf quest, when it should only require starting it.
** Corrected the spelling of Canifis on the Clue Compass teleport menu.
* Miscellaneous fixes:
** Fixed a bug where Tormented Demons teleport could not be used without the quest requirements.
** Gabooty now properly shows up in Karamja as intended.
** The League Summary page now tracks and displays "Players Killed". Additionally, "Time Played" has been updated to "Account Age" for better clarity.
** Veliaf Hurtz from the Sins of the Father quest is now in the right location.
** Slayer helmets can now be properly recoloured.
** Tombs of Amascut can no longer be accessed early by using the banker's briefcase from the Bank Heist relic.
** Echo Hunllef no longer stretches during its death animation.
** Golden tench now has a chance to be dropped as intended both in Leagues and main game worlds.

update: More Doom Tweaks, Poll 84, & Summer Sweep Up Changes
change:
* Standard attacks from the Doom after a melee punish will now take into account rock throw projectiles, ensuring that two styles will never overlap (i.e. a melee projectile when a magic projectile from the rock throw is inbound). This still means that there are two attacks of the same style inbound if the player melee punishes too early, thus missing the prayer will result in the full impact of both attacks.
* Attacks that are nulled during the transition to the Doom's shielded form will now instead count as damage towards the shield, even if the damage came from a non-demonbane weapon.
* A bug in which the Doom's burrowed form deals trample damage whilst zooming diagonally, even if the player is not standing within its path, has been fixed.
* Rocks which fall when the Doom begins to burrow will no longer disappear when landing on acid blood.
* Players will no longer get pushed out-of-bounds when the burrow hole spawns in a corner.
* The burrow hole will no longer sparkle when a player receives a duplicate pet drop.

* Further altered the shape of the Ranged projectile to ensure it appears noticeably different to Melee.
* Fixed a bug where valuable loot drops received from the Doom of Mokhaiotl did not broadcast to the clan chat.

* The Doom's transition to the shielded phase is now triggered by his attack timer instead of on-hit. To avoid instant phase transitions, he will also wait for 2 attacks after the last orb phase before triggering the shield.
* The Doom can no longer heal unintentionally after firing his beam.
* Giant larvae will now stay in place when KO damage is incoming, to match the behaviour of small larvae.

* The holy water effect should now be guaranteed when killing the boss during the melee punish phase.
* To prevent a bug that allowed the Doom to start a melee punish phase before switching to the blue shield phase a few ticks later, the beam charge during the melee punish phase can no longer be interrupted by grub damage.
* Larvae no longer despawn and persist into the car phase.
* The surge potion cooldown timer now pauses between delve levels.
* Fixed a bug that caused some projectile attacks to be nullified when the Doom switched from the melee punish to the blue shield phase.
* Fixed a bug that caused larvae spawning in to have an expanded clickbox that could overlap with volatile earth.

* Re-equipping the lightbearer between delve levels no longer causes special attack energy to resume regenerating.
* Giant demonic larvae will no longer incur attack delays even when using demonbane weapons.

* Loot:
** Elite clue scrolls have been added to the drop table, with a drop rate of 1/75 for delve levels 1 and 2, and a drop rate of 1/50 for delve levels 3+.
** The burrow hole will now glow yellow when a unique item has been rolled.
** Unclaimed loot from the burrow hole can now be retrieved from a chest in the lobby if players leave before claiming loot. The loot interface can now also be accessed from further away.
* Special Beam Cannon/melee punish:
** The charging effects were slightly shrunken to reduce the chance of misclicking.
** Firing of the Special Beam Cannon has been delayed by one tick (0.6s).
** The standard attack delay has been removed if the player is about to perform a melee punish.
** Recurrent damage from a melee punish will now trigger the holy water effect if it results in the Doom's defeat.
** The holy water effect will now restore a flat amount of 32 Hitpoints, 24 prayer points, and 25% special attack energy. Previously, they would restore players to 49 health and prayer points if they were lower than that.
* Demonic larvae:
** Triple larvae spawns at delve levels 8+ have been replaced with a single giant demonic larva that has doubled health, a larger explosion radius, and tripled penalties if allowed to reach the Doom.
** Larvae will now try to spawn further away from the boss in addition to spawning on the same side as the player.
** Melee larvae will now only appear during the shield phase.
** Ranged larvae will now be one-shot when attacking with holy water equipped
** Magic larvae will now be one-shot when attacking with the Eye of Ayak, which also now grants the attack delay-removing effect given by demonbane weapons.
* Shockwave:
** Permanent rocks from the Rock Throw attack will no longer appear if the player is struck by it whilst under the protection of the earthen shield.
** The centre tile of the earthen shield will now remove any acid blood in its path.
* Other:
** The bone dagger's special attack now correctly guarantees a hit against the Doom when used on the first hit:
** Special attack energy no longer regenerates when the Doom is not present.
** The current delve level now appears in the Doom's health overlay, if enabled.
** The Doom's clickbox has been adjusted to help prevent players from clicking through it when they intended to attack.
** Rock Throw attacks are now less likely to be used in succession.
** The colour of the melee projectiles has been adjusted to be clearer for players with visual impairments.
** The dwarven multicannon can no longer be placed in the delve level 1 area.

* Demonbane spells now benefit from reduced attack delay on demonic larvae.
* A bug causing loot from previous waves to not always appear in the 'Investigate' interface has been fixed.
* The clickbox for volatile earth nodes no longer appear before their spawn animation has finished.
* Clan broadcasts will now only trigger for waves 1-8 for a player's personal best rather than on every completion.
* The size of the beam charge-up effect has been reduced to help prevent misclicks.

* Players with the sigil of nature can now complete the "Have Prissy Scilla protect your Magic tree" task in the Western Province Diary via Prissy's right-click "Pay" option.

Breach NPCs should no longer spawn inside the walls at Zanaris.

update: Deadman: Annihilation Tweaks, Shellbane Gryphon CAs & More!
change:

* The deadman's chests now correctly takes 60 seconds to open in singles and 30 seconds in multi, whereas previously it took 80 seconds and 41 seconds respectively.
* The limit on starter pack reclaims for non-PvP deaths has been removed.
** Players can now receive an unlimited amount of starter packs from the combat tutors in Lumbridge, or Brugsen Bursen at the Grand Exchange.
** Teleport cards received are now converted into charges already stored in the chronicle.
* The Strength level of Zemouregal Summons has been reduced from 300 to 150.
* The number of Deadman: Annihilation worlds per bracket has been adjusted to better match player demand.
* The hitpoints for nearly all breach monsters has been increased to account for the increase in player numbers.
* The damage dealt by the breach Yama meteor has been reduced across all brackets. 
** In the 3-60 bracket specifically, the meteor’s damage will now max between 20 and 30, while in all other brackets it will max between 30-60.
* Ancient warrior equipment can now be bought and sold on the Grand Exchange.
* The scroll of redirection can be bought from the emblem trader, allowing players to complete the medium Desert Diary.
* Attempting to pickpocket a Hero in Ardougne with 80 Thieving will now complete the diary task.
* The descriptions for the sigil of nature and sigil of enhanced harvest now state that they do not have an effect at Tithe Farm.
* The weapons shown when opening the trinket of advanced weaponry are now more distinct.
The name of the quest was changed from Tutorial Island to Learning the Ropes.

update: Grid Master Rewards, Poll & New Player Improvements
change: The Tutorial Island became a trackable quest.

update: Sailing Changes and Gem Bag Expansion
change:
* Removed some of the Leagues VI worlds.
* Both Heavy and Light Ballista weapons now benefit from the node that says "While a crossbow is equipped, you have a +15% chance to trigger Ranged echoes".
* The Fire Spell pact's burn effect now also applies to enemies in single-way combat areas.
* Sage's axe now properly works on Moons of Peril.
* Killing any Wallasalki should now complete the "Defeat a Wallasalki" task.
* The Banker's Briefcase now includes the teleports to the deposit boxes introduced with Sailing.
* Resolved a graphical issue that occurred when King's barrage was equipped alongside Echo boots or Mixed hide boots.

* Added an extra free pact reset which will be granted when you open the pacts interface.
* The dramen staff no longer counts as a blindbag weapon.
* The pact descriptions of all ranged echoes and the 2-handed melee echo have been updated to clarify that these cannot be triggered with special attacks.
* Thorns no longer prevent completion of Combat Achievements that require only magic damage.
* The minion summoned from the Minion relic will now attack Sol Heredit if the player engages him in combat.
* The prayers Piety and Chivalry now stay unlocked after picking Kandarin with the Grimoire relic.
* The abyssal tentacle is now being affected by regeneration nodes, allowing it to save charges.
* Lithic sceptre no longer loses charges upon using the Flask of Fervour.
* Lithic Sceptre now correctly requires 5 shatter stacks and is no longer blocked by Tombs of Amascut's "Overly Draining" invocation.
* Flask of fervour now properly blocks certain damage in its invulnerability phase. Upon using the Flask:
** Status effects such as bleed, poison and venom will now get cleared.
** Pact nodes that consume overhealed Hitpoints will now take the immunity into account.
** All PvP damage will be negated.
* The Transmution spells Alchemic Convergence and Alchemic Divergence now correctly display as costing no runes and are highlighted to indicate they are available to use.
* Cooking in The Gauntlet and Corrupted Gauntlet is no longer slower with the Flow State relic active.
* A Zanaris bank teleport option has been added to the banker's briefcase.
* Chopping the redwood tree in the Farming Guild now works with the Endless Harvest and Woodsman relics active.
* Bones are now automatically sent to your bank alongside your other Hunter loot when checking hunter traps with the Woodsman relic active.
* The task to complete His Faithful Servants is now auto-completed upon unlocking Morytania after the Desert.
* The Yama Combat Achievement "No toppings, no drinks, thanks" can now be completed with healing-related demonic pacts.
* The "I was here first!" Combat Achievement now auto-completes upon joining Leagues VI for the first time.
* Equipping avernic treads made using ranger boots will now trigger and count toward the “Equip Ranger Boots” task. You can complete the task while wearing any of the following:
** Ranger boots, avernic treads (max), avernic treads (pe), avernic treads (pe)(et), avernic treads (pr)(pe) & pegasian boots
* Similarly, equipping primordial boots or avernic treads made using melee boots will now trigger and count toward the tasks to equip a pair of dragon boots in Asgarnia and the Wilderness. The task can be completed with:
** Dragon boots, dragon boots (g), dragon boots (cr), primordial boots, avernic treads (max), avernic treads (pr)(pe), avernic treads (pr)(et) & avernic treads (pr)
* The elven rabbit cave in Tirannwn is now instanced in Leagues worlds. The rabbit will spawn immediately upon entry, making it easier to obtain the crystal grail and complete the task to equip it.
* The following items now count for the "Equip some Black Armour" task:
** Black full helm, black full helm (t), black full helm (g), black platebody, black platebody (t), black platebody (g), black platelegs, black platelegs (t) & black platelegs (g)
* Using the Bake Pie spell now correctly counts toward all “bake pie” tasks.
* The 12x XP multiplier now correctly states it unlocks at Tier 4, and the 16x XP multiplier now correctly states it unlocks at Tier 6.
* The master clue steps that requires access to the Obelisk of Air and that require arclight within the Catacombs of Kourend are no longer being given this Leagues, with Misthalin disabled.
* The Morge clue step can now be completed:
** Upon unlocking Karamja, the Pirate Pete subquest will be auto-completed.
** Murphy in Port Khazard will now give you the diving equipment.
* During the orb phase of the Doom of Mokhaiotl, striking a volatile earth with double-hitting weapons will no longer cause the orb to spawn and despawn.
* World 581 has been removed from Leagues VI.

* The toxic and drygore blowpipe now correctly benefit from the ammo regeneration pacts.
* Canoe transportation in Kandarin should now work correctly.
* Asgarnia seeds now transmute properly into other seeds.
* Barbarian Gathering now correctly gives high tier logs from Wilderness ents.
* The task to pickpocket a diamond from TzHaar-Hur can now be completed with the Larcenist relic active.
* On League worlds, hydra tail now drops as a bonecrusher necklace from regular hydras.
* The Leviathan task 'Unconventional' can now be completed when using ranged echoes or thorns.
* Completing all three of the thermonuclear smoke devil's Combat Achievements now also completes the associated hard League task.
* Updated the name of "Chop a dense jungle" task to "Fully clear a dense jungle" to clarify what needs to be done. This task will also be completed if you find a gem rock or a gout tuber in the dense jungle.
* "Complete the Corrupted Gauntlet in 4:30" task now completes upon finishing within the stated time.
* The clue scroll requiring the 'BJR 1123' fairy ring will now be given to players who have unlocked Kandarin, Karamja and Asgarnia.
* The clue step requiring to search a chest in Varrock is no longer being given in Leagues.
* Dying to poison after engaging in a PvP fight no longer causes players to lose their items on the next death.

* "Defeat Hueycoatl 1 time" has now become a pact reset task, which means completing it will give a reset point. If you've already completed this task, you'll be retroactively granted the reset point upon opening the pacts interface.
* Pact points have been added to the following existing pact tasks: (If you've already completed these pact tasks, pact points will be added to your account retroactively upon opening the pacts interface. Note that the 40 pact points max limit will still apply.)
** Equip an obsidian cape
** Equip any piece of armour from the Moons of Peril
** Equip an echo weapon
** Complete 1 deep delve at the Doom of Mokhaiotl
* Implemented improvements to rebalance some Demonic Pacts.
** The boost for all Prayer penetration nodes have been increased to 25% from 15%.
** The boost for accuracy small nodes have been increased to 25% from 15%, and big nodes to 50% from 35%.
** Small % damage nodes for Magic, Ranged and Melee now also give 10% to global accuracy.
* Implemented rebalancing changes to some echo bosses.
* The bow and powered staff within The Gauntlet will now correctly "Regenerate" ammo/charges, the same as the exception that was applied to the Bow of Faerdhinen pre-launch. This means the weapons will now benefit from various pacts.
* Echo Thermonuclear smoke devil will now trigger thorns on its basic attacks.
* Upon unlocking Asgarnia:
** A Porcine of Interest, Sheep Shearer, Cook's Assistant and Restless Ghost quests will be auto-completed. This will also allow you to purchase the Lumbridge painting from Sir Renitee for 2,000 coins.
** The task "Give Thurgo a redberry pie" will be auto-completed.
** If you've already unlocked Asgarnia, all of the above will be retroactively completed when you next open the area/relic interface.
* Upon unlocking Kandarin:
** Elemental Workshop II quest and the task to complete it will be auto-completed.
** Likewise, the Skrach Uglogwee subquest from Recipe for Disaster will be auto-completed. This will also allow you to get raw jubblies by baiting them with balloon toads.
** If you've already unlocked Kandarin, all of the above will be retroactively completed when you next open the area/relic interface.
* Upon unlocking the Kharidian Desert:
** Shadow of the Storm quest and the task to complete it will be auto-completed.
** If you've already unlocked the desert, the above will be retroactively completed when you next open the area/relic interface.
* Upon unlocking Morytania:
** The task "Smuggle some rum" will be auto-completed.
** The "Use an Ectophial to return to Port Phasmatys" medium diary will be auto-completed. This will also allow you to get Morytania legs 2, which provides the ghostspeak amulet effect for claiming an ectophial.
** If you've already unlocked Morytania, all of the above will be retroactively completed when you next open the area/relic interface.
* Upon unlocking Kourend:
** The task "Craft 100 Aether Runes" will be auto-completed.
** If you've already unlocked Kourend, the above will be retroactively completed when you next open the area/relic interface.
* A new task has been added to the Fremennik Province: "Defeat Vorkath 15 times without leaving the area" which has replaced the "Equip a Dragon Crossbow" task.
* Decorating a magic totem in Auburn Valley now completes both of the "Fully Decorate a Redwood Totem in the Auburn Valley" and "Fully Decorate a Magic Totem in the Auburn Valley" tasks.
* Casting Paddewwa Teleport spell in the desert will now complete the task, without actually teleporting the player.
* Flask of Fervour now will no longer clear any antipoison you may have had.
* Bert will now correctly deliver sand to your bank and properly update the Kandarin Diary progress.
* Ammo fired from Dizana's quiver will now regenerate correctly.
* Endless Harvest no longer prevents trees grown in tree patches from depleting or being chopped down.
* Endless Harvest will now automatically move to a new fishing spot, and and this should apply to all fish types.
* Chopping magic logs in Tirannwn and Varlamore now correctly count for their respective tasks for the Endless Harvest relic.
* The Flow State relic now correctly works with auto-chiselling dense essence blocks.
* Grimoire relic now lets you use the Ourania Teleport.
* The task to fletch 250 redwood logs into arrow shafts can now successfully be completed when you have the Woodsman relic active. This can’t be amended retroactively, so the task may need to be repeated to complete it.
* With the Hotfoot relic active:
** The Ape Atoll Agility Course will now give 2x laps.
** The Prifddinas Agility Course will now give 2x laps.
** The Varlamore Agility Course's leaderboard has been corrected to display the 2x laps.
** The Brimhaven Agility ticket pillars will now give at least 2 before the passive modifiers.
* Players with Barbarian Gathering can now complete the fishing section of the Barbarian Training miniquest.
* Tasks assigned by Slayer Masters in Leagues VI now match their lists in the main game worlds, but Slayer Masters will still respect your area unlocks.
* Slayer tasks for bosses now function and roll out correctly with Culling Spree.
* Soul shards can now be used to craft combo runes like sunfire runes.
* Fixed a bug where Twisted Banshees weren't retaliating.

* Endless Harvest no longer prevents trees grown in tree patches from depleting or being chopped down.
* Endless Harvest will now automatically move to a new fishing spot, and this applies to all fish types.
* Chopping Magic Logs in Tirannwn and Varlamore now correctly count for their respective tasks for the Endless Harvest relic.
Players with the Barbarian Gathering relic can now complete the Fishing section of the Barbarian Training miniquest.

* Added an extra free pact reset (for a total of 6).
* The dramen staff no longer counts as a blindbag weapon.
* The pact descriptions of all ranged echoes and the 2-handed melee echo have been updated to clarify that these cannot be triggered with special attacks.
* Thorns no longer prevent completion of Combat Achievements that require only magic damage.
* The abyssal tentacle is now being affected by regeneration nodes, allowing it to save charges.
* The Yama Combat Achievement "No toppings, no drinks, thanks" can now be completed with healing-related demonic pacts.

* "Defeat Hueycoatl 1 time" has now become a pact reset task, which means completing it will give a reset point (for a total of 5). If you've already completed this task, you'll be retroactively granted the reset point upon opening the pacts interface.
* Pact points have been added to the following existing pact tasks: (If you've already completed these pact tasks, pact points will be added to your account retroactively upon opening the pacts interface. Note that the 40 pact points max limit will still apply.)
** Equip an obsidian cape
** Equip any piece of armour from the Moons of Peril
** Equip an echo weapon
** Complete 1 deep delve at the Doom of Mokhaiotl
* Implemented improvements to rebalance some Demonic Pacts:
** The boost for all Prayer penetration nodes have been increased to 25% from 15%.
** The boost for accuracy small nodes have been increased to 25% from 15%, and big nodes to 50% from 35%.
** Small % damage nodes for Magic, Ranged and Melee now also give 10% to global accuracy.
* The crystal/corrupted bow and crystal/corrupted staff within The Gauntlet will now correctly "Regenerate" ammo/charges, the same as the exception that was applied to the Bow of Faerdhinen pre-launch. This means the weapons will now benefit from various pacts.
